description:
Vegur is our steel or stainless allroader, well suited for those winding gravelroads, forestlanes (and possibly even paved roads..)

It is an evolution of all the Vegurs I’ve built with project12 over the years. Biggest change is the headtube coming from a 44mm ZS/EC to an integrated 52mm headtube that makes room for all internal cables.

All the photos you seen here are of the project12 Vegurs as we are working on the first UNpaved Vegur.

Vegur has a T47 bottombracket, 3D printed UDH/Transmission compatible dropouts for 140mm flatmount brakes and room for at least 45mm tyres.

A tailored tubeset in combination with the pencil thin seatstays give Vegur a comfortable yet firm ride, perfect for long days in the saddle on varied terrain.

We offer Vegur only in steel at the moment, either a Columbus Zona/Spirit tubeset, or a fillet brazed Columbus XCR stainless steel tubeset.

Vegur comes standard with internal routing and mounts for 3 bottlecages and a toptubebag. Other mounts are optional at a surcharge.

Vegur is (of course) UDH and Transmission compatible and standard 140mm flatmount.

Using the T47 bottom bracket for added stiffness and durability. Vegur will fit either 1x or 2x drivetrains with 50mm max tyres.

Every Vegur is handmade to measure in our workshop in Wijchen, the Netherlands.

If you have any wishes or ideas don’t hesitate to get in contact.
